features: First public release of Local Lib: a local-first library and reader for PDF, EPUB, MOBI/AZW3, DjVu, DOCX/ODT, CBZ and more
Highlights, notes, bookmarks, ink and area selections, with a notebook, Markdown/PDF export and Readwise/KOReader integrations
Full-text search across the whole library, plus optional semantic search with embeddings
AI assistant over a book or the whole library (Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI-compatible or local models), chapter summaries and whole-book overviews
Identify with AI: finds a document's DOI or ISBN from its first pages and fetches the full record
Read aloud with offline neural voices (Kokoro, Piper), voice questions while listening, and audiobook export to M4B with chapters
Flashcards with FSRS scheduling, image-occlusion cards from diagrams, reading goals, stats and study plans
Discover and download from OPDS catalogs, Open Library, Project Gutenberg and GitHub sources, with saved syncs
Citations in 10,000+ CSL styles, a cite-while-you-write palette and a browser connector compatible with Zotero
Encrypted sync and backups through a cloud folder, WebDAV, Dropbox, Google Drive or OneDrive
Scanned-book OCR (macOS Vision or Tesseract) and in-app updates
